name: Counter-Strike: Global Offensive
start: [ -f bin/libgcc_s.so.1 ] && mv bin/libgcc_s.so.1 bin/libgcc_s.so.1.bak; echo -n 730 > steam_appid.txt; ./srcds_run -game csgo -usercon -strictportbind -ip 0.0.0.0 -port {{port}} +clientport {{port_3}} +tv_port {{port_2}} +sv_setsteamaccount {{gslt}} -tickrate {{tickrate}} +map {{defaultmap}} +servercfgfile panel.cfg -maxplayers_override {{maxplayers}} +mapgroup mg_active +game_type 0 +game_mode {{gamemode}} +sv_game_mode_flags 0 +sv_skirmish_id 0 +host_workshop_collection +workshop_start_map -authkey -nobreakpad -norestart
notes: Automatisch aus LinuxGSM übernommen. Selbsttest bestanden.
